status: sample retrieved and parsed; internal FITS checksum warnings documented

fits_integrity.DATASUM: not present in the three HDUs
fits_integrity.handling: The FITS file opens and parses to 1,639 light-curve rows; preserve the original bytes and identify them by the recorded SHA-256. Do not treat failed HDU checksums as a clean validation.

selection.center_definition: Batalha et al. (2011) discovery epoch + one discovery-period interval
selection.quality_policy: Retain original SAP_QUALITY integer for every selected cadence. No bitmask is recoded and no quality-based row filtering is applied to the window. The Q1 counts are reported separately.

columns_and_units.relative_flux_ppm: Derived as (PDCSAP_FLUX / Q1 median of finite SAP_QUALITY=0 rows - 1) * 1e6
columns_and_units.relative_flux_err_ppm: Derived as PDCSAP_FLUX_ERR / same Q1 median * 1e6

transit_parameters.scope: Values reported in the discovery paper; they are not refit from the 25-row instructional window.

reproduction.dependencies: Python 3, NumPy, Astropy, and the repository's Node.js dependencies
reproduction.note: The script reads the archived FITS already stored in this folder and regenerates the compact observed-data JSON. The recorded derived_window_sha256 is calculated after the Prettier step; running extraction alone produces a different byte-level JSON serialization.

rights_and_presentation.observed_data: Public MAST mission product; source URL and retrieval hash accompany the local teaching subset.
rights_and_presentation.generated_images: Conceptual illustrations; never represented as Kepler observations.
rights_and_presentation.paper_figures: Figures 3, 6, 8, 10, and 11 are displayed with visible citation and a link to the source article.
